description: Close a document. save_changes is required and has no default, because InDesign save dialogs are suppressed. Pass path to save under a new name; it is required for a document that has never been saved when save_changes is "yes". Returns saved_to, had_unsaved_changes and the remaining document ids. Note: merely opening a document can already set had_unsaved_changes true.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

path.description: Save-as target path. Required when save_changes is "yes" and the document was never saved.

save_changes.description: Required. "yes" saves before closing, "no" discards unsaved changes.

name: close_document
title: Close a document
